en-US.headline: Baodi District Meteorological Observatory issues yellow warning for heavy fog/level III/severe
en-US.description: The Baodi District Meteorological Observatory issued a yellow warning signal for heavy fog at 19:25 on November 11, 2026: It is expected that from tonight to tomorrow morning, all streets and towns in our district will experience fog with visibility less than 1 kilometer, some areas with visibility less than 500 meters, and some areas with visibility less than 200 meters. Relevant units and personnel are requested to be prepared for prevention.

zh-CN.headline: 宝坻区气象台发布大雾黄色预警/Ⅲ级/较重
zh-CN.description: 宝坻区气象台于2026年11月11日19时25分发布大雾黄色预警信号：预计今天夜间到明天早晨，我区所有街镇将出现能见度小于1千米的雾，部分地区能见度小于500米，局地能见度不足200米，请有关单位和人员做好防范准备。

en-US.headline: Xinlin District Meteorological Observatory issues yellow warning for road ice and snow [Level III/Heavy]
en-US.description: The Xinlin District Meteorological Observatory issued a yellow warning signal for road ice and snow at 07:06 on November 12, 2026: It is expected that the road surface temperature will be below 0 ℃ in the next 24 hours, with rainy and snowy weather, and there will be road icing or snow accumulation, which will have a certain impact on traffic.
en-US.area: 1. Transportation, public security and other departments should prepare for road icing or snow accumulation according to their responsibilities;

zh-CN.headline: 新林区气象台发布道路冰雪黄色预警[III级/较重]
zh-CN.description: 新林区气象台2026年11月12日07时06分发布道路冰雪黄色预警信号：预计未来24小时内，路表温度低于0℃，有雨雪天气，将出现道路结冰或积雪，对交通有一定影响。 防御指南： 1.交通、公安等部门要按照职责做好道路结冰或积雪的应对准备工作； 2.驾驶人员应当注意路况，安全行驶； 3.行人外出尽量少骑自行车，注意防滑。

en-US.headline: Yuhang District Meteorological Observatory in Hangzhou City issues a blue frost warning [Level IV/General]
en-US.description: The Yuhang District Meteorological Observatory in Hangzhou City will continue to issue a blue frost warning signal at 15:12 on November 10, 2026: Due to the combined effects of cold air and radiation cooling, it is expected that the lowest temperature in towns and streets such as Baizhang, Luoniao, Huanghu, Jingshan, etc. in our district will drop below 4 ℃ tomorrow morning. There will be frost, and all relevant parties should pay attention to preventing the adverse effects of frost on agriculture and forestry.
en-US.instruction: 1. The government and relevant departments should make preparations for frost prevention; 2. Take certain protective measures for crops such as tea, vegetables, flowers, fruits, etc.

zh-CN.headline: 杭州市余杭区气象台发布霜冻蓝色预警[Ⅳ级/一般]
zh-CN.description: 杭州市余杭区气象台2026年11月10日15时12分继续发布霜冻蓝色预警信号：受冷空气和辐射降温共同影响，预计明天早晨我区百丈、鸬鸟、黄湖、径山等镇、街道最低气温将降至4℃以下，有霜冻，请各有关方面注意防范霜冻对农业、林业产生的不利影响。
zh-CN.instruction: 1.政府及相关部门做好防霜冻准备工作； 2.对茶叶、蔬菜、花卉、瓜果等作物采取一定防护措施。

sender: Yuhang District Meteorological Observatory, Hangzhou City
